title: UC model load and register must switch artifact repo together via the SDK-models env flag
answers: UC model load or register uses scoped vended credentials and fails on DBR 15.4
route Unity Catalog model download and upload through the Files API
load_model models:/catalog.schema.model works but log_model to UC still uses cloud creds
body:
Symptom: Loading or registering a Unity Catalog model (models:/catalog.schema.model/version on databricks-uc) fails or is blocked on DBR 15.4 LTS because scoped vended tokens are no longer allowed.
Root cause: mlflow/store/artifact/unity_catalog_models_artifact_repo.py:UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo (load) and mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo (register) each pick the artifact repo; both must check MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC.
Fix pattern: Gate any new UC model artifact path on the same flag, read at call time (.get()), and return DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository with the registry or store URI passed as registry_uri so credentials resolve. Keep the scoped-token branch as the default (flag False).
Constraints: With the flag unset, behavior must match the scoped-cloud-credential path. Changing only one of the two paths leaves load and register on different transports. Applies to databricks-uc model paths only, not UC Volumes.
applies: Unity Catalog model-registry artifact routing (load and register paths) in mlflow/store/artifact and mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry.
says: Model loading and registration in Unity Catalog fails after upgrading to Databricks runtime 15.4.
Publishing a catalog model still attempts to use legacy cloud credentials and gets blocked.
Enable the files API transport for catalog models to avoid deprecated storage token errors.
Model downloads succeed from the catalog but saving back to the catalog is denied.
search: Loading or registering models in Unity Catalog on DBR 15.4 LTS fails when scoped vended tokens are disallowed, requiring both paths to route through DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository via MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC. Both UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo (for load) and UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo (for register) must check this flag at call time, passing registry_uri or store_uri so credentials resolve properly. Gating only one path leaves download and upload on mismatched transports, while keeping the flag unset preserves default scoped-credential behavior. This routing rule applies specifically to databricks-uc model registry paths and does not apply to UC Volumes.
